{{Quote|I was six, I think, first time I touched a funerary stone. Heard our music, felt our history. Holding my sister's hand as we walked all the way from Fountain Square.|Maarva Andor|<ref name="Rix Road" />}}
A [[Gender|female]] individual was the '''sister''' of the [[human]] female [[Maarva Carassi Andor]]. Around [[76 BBY]],<ref name="Date">"[[Rix Road (episode)|Rix Road]]" dates Maarva Andor's [[Reproduction|birth]] to 7895 [[Coruscant reckoning calendar|C.R.C.]] ''[[Star Wars: Scum and Villainy: Case Files on the Galaxy's Most Notorious]]'' dates the [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|assassination attempt]] on [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] to 7955 C.R.C., which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[22 BBY]], therefore 7895 C.R.C. is approximately equivalent to [[82 BBY]]. Consequently, Maarva Andor would've been six years old in around [[76 BBY]].</ref> she walked with her sister down [[Rix Road]] from [[Fountain Square]], where Maarva first encountered the Ferrixian tradition of a [[funerary stone]].<ref name="Rix Road" />
